decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 2 - The advertisment structures hereby approved shall not be illuminated and shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed non-illuminated advertisements, due to their compatible scale, appearance and position, would not detract from the character and appearance of the building, and would not harm the living conditions of local residents, or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Installation of 2 non-illuminated adverts to roof of building
